document_title: Master Leave Policy & Handbook Guidelines: 50+ Comprehensive Leave Scenarios
author: Human Resources Management & People Operations

overview.purpose: To provide an exhaustive, policy-compliant repository of 50 distinct leave rules, accrual mechanics, approval tiers, and encashment regulations for all full-time employees at My-Bio-Medical.

leave_policy_entries.rule: Annual casual leave allowance is fixed at 12 days per calendar year.
Casual leaves accrue at the rate of 1 day per month following probation confirmation.
Must be applied for at least 2 working days in advance via the HR portal.
Maximum consecutive casual leave days permitted at any one time is 3 days.
Unused casual leaves do not carry forward and lapse automatically on December 31st.
Casual leaves are strictly non-encashable upon employment separation.
Cannot be prefixed or suffixed with earned leave without prior manager approval.
New hires joining mid-year receive a pro-rated casual leave balance rounded to the nearest half-day.
Annual sick leave allowance is fixed at 8 days per calendar year.
Available for use from Day 1 of official employment.
Intimation must be provided to manager and HR within 2 hours of the shift start.
A medical certificate from a registered practitioner is mandatory for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days.
Unused sick leaves lapse at the end of the calendar year and cannot be carried forward.
Sick leaves are non-encashable under all operational circumstances.
Can be utilized for urgent medical appointments or mental health recovery days.
Annual earned leave allowance is fixed at 15 days per calendar year.
Accrued monthly at 1.25 days per month for all permanent employees following probation.
Planned leaves exceeding 5 consecutive days require at least 2 weeks' prior written notice.
Requires formal department head sign-off for extended holiday blocks over 10 days.
Maximum of 30 unused earned leave days can be carried forward into the subsequent year.
Earned leave encashment is permitted during annual payroll audits or formal separation.
Encashment payout is capped at a maximum of 15 days per calendar year.
Earned leave balance cannot drop below zero (negative balances are strictly prohibited).
Total maternity leave duration is 26 weeks for eligible female employees.
Requires at least 80 days of continuous service within the 12 months preceding expected delivery.
Formal notification and medical certificate submission to HR at least 8 weeks prior to commencement.
Can commence up to 8 weeks prior to the expected date of delivery.
Fully paid leave in accordance with statutory guidelines and corporate health benefits.
Non-encashable and structured strictly around qualifying pregnancy and postpartum care.
Includes provision for an additional 4 weeks of flexible remote work upon return from leave.
Total paternity leave duration is 2 weeks (14 calendar days) for eligible employees.
Applicable to all male or secondary caregiver employees who have completed probation.
Must be availed within 6 months following the birth or legal adoption of a child.
Requires a minimum of 10 business days' advance notice submitted to HR.
Can be split into two separate 1-week blocks with manager consent.
Non-encashable and expires if unused within the 6-month statutory window.
Accrued based on authorized weekend or emergency public holiday work.
Applicable to exempt and non-exempt staff requested by management for critical deployments.
Must be pre-approved in writing by the respective department head.
Must be logged in the HR portal within 5 business days of the worked weekend.
Comp-off credits must be utilized within 60 days of accrual, failing which they expire.
Strictly non-encashable under all circumstances.
Unauthorized absence for 3 consecutive working days may be treated as job abandonment.
HR reserves the right to audit leave records and request documentation when abuse is suspected.
Up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave granted for immediate family member loss.
Long-term unpaid sabbatical of up to 3 months available after 5 years of continuous service.
Fully paid leave granted for mandatory court appearances and jury duty summons.
Up to 5 days of educational leave per year for company-approved certification exams.
Employees receive 10 standard corporate paid holidays per calendar year.
My-Bio-Medical management reserves the right to amend leave policies in alignment with regional labor laws.
